result.instructions: Tools for Sortly, hosted by usefulapi.io. Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Sortly data. Free plan: 100 tool calls per month. Run sortly_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run sortly_request_feature to record the request. Pro (unlimited calls, $9/month or $90/year): when the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run sortly_upgrade; it returns a Stripe Checkout link for the user to open. sortly_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: sortly_list_items
tools.title: List items and folders
tools.description: List items and folders, newest first. By default the root level; pass folder_id for a folder's direct contents, plus include_subfolders for everything nested under it. Paginated via meta.next_page_url / total_pages. Sortly: GET /api/v1/items.

folder_id.description: Only the direct contents of this folder. Omit for the root level.

include_subfolders.description: With folder_id: also return everything nested beneath it. Default false.

include.description: Nested associations to embed: custom_attributes and/or photos.

tools.name: sortly_get_item
tools.title: Get one item or folder
tools.description: Fetch a single item or folder by numeric id: quantity, min_quantity, price, tags, sid, barcodes, and optionally custom field values and photos. Sortly: GET /api/v1/items/{item_id}.

item_id.description: The item's or folder's numeric id.

include.description: Nested associations to embed: custom_attributes and/or photos.

tools.name: sortly_search_items
tools.title: Search inventory
tools.description: Search items and folders by name, optionally limited to items or folders and scoped to specific folders. Read-only despite being a POST. Paginated: send the same arguments with the next page number. Sortly: POST /api/v1/items/search.

name.description: Name (or part of it) to search for.

type.description: Limit to items or folders. Default all.

include_subfolders.description: With folder_ids: also search folders nested under them. Default false.

sort.description: Sort by name, ascending or descending.

include.description: Nested associations to embed: custom_attributes and/or photos.

tools.name: sortly_list_recently_updated_items
tools.title: List recently updated items
tools.description: List items and folders changed since a Unix timestamp — the incremental-sync read ('what moved since yesterday?'). Without updated_since it behaves like sortly_list_items. Sortly: GET /api/v1/items/recent.

updated_since.description: Unix epoch seconds; only items updated after this.

folder_id.description: Only the direct contents of this folder. Omit for the root level.

include_subfolders.description: With folder_id: also return everything nested beneath it. Default false.

include.description: Nested associations to embed: custom_attributes and/or photos.

tools.name: sortly_list_custom_fields
tools.title: List custom fields
tools.description: List the account's custom fields (id, name, type, applies_to). Call this before writing custom_attribute_values to get the right custom_attribute_id. Sortly: GET /api/v1/custom_fields.

tools.name: sortly_list_units
tools.title: List units of measure
tools.description: List the units of measure available to the account (unit_name, unit_type, scale) — the values measured_quantity and purchase-order lines expect. Sortly: GET /api/v1/units.

tools.name: sortly_list_alerts
tools.title: List alerts
tools.description: List stock (Quantity) and date (DateReminder) alerts, with is_fired showing which have already triggered — the quick way to find low-stock items. Sortly: GET /api/v1/alerts.

tools.name: sortly_list_jobs
tools.title: List jobs
tools.description: List jobs (work orders that pull stock out), most recently updated first, filterable by name prefix and status. Paginated via meta.pagination.has_next. Sortly: GET /api/v1/jobs.

name.description: Jobs whose name starts with this (case-insensitive).

tools.name: sortly_get_job
tools.title: Get one job
tools.description: Fetch a single job: status, folder_id (where its pulled items sit), dates, notes, custom field values and the version needed for updates. Sortly: GET /api/v1/jobs/{job_id}.

tools.name: sortly_list_purchase_orders
tools.title: List purchase orders
tools.description: List purchase orders, most recently updated first, filterable by PO number and status. The list leaves out notes, terms, sub_total and line_items — use sortly_get_purchase_order for those. Needs Purchase Orders on the plan (else 402). Sortly: GET /api/v1/purchase_orders.

tools.name: sortly_get_purchase_order
tools.title: Get one purchase order
tools.description: Fetch a single purchase order with its line_items (quantity vs received_quantity), vendor, addresses, charges, totals and version. Sortly: GET /api/v1/purchase_orders/{purchase_order_id}.

tools.name: sortly_get_purchase_order_receive_status
tools.title: Get a purchase order's receive status
tools.description: Report the most recent receive against a purchase order: pending / completed / failed, with the line ids received, pending and failed (and why). Returns 404 until something has been received. Sortly: GET /api/v1/purchase_orders/{purchase_order_id}/receive/status.

annotations.title: Get a purchase order's receive status

tools.name: sortly_create_item
tools.title: Create an item or folder
tools.description: Create a trackable item (type item) or a folder (type folder), optionally inside a folder via parent_id, with quantity, price, tags, custom fields, barcodes and a measured quantity. WRITE. Sortly: POST /api/v1/items.

type.description: item = trackable stock; folder = a container.

parent_id.description: Folder to create it in. Omit/null = root.

min_quantity.description: Minimum level; a Quantity alert can fire when stock reaches it.

custom_attribute_values.description: Custom field values. Look up ids with sortly_list_custom_fields first.

value.description: Value to store; null clears it.

label_url.description: Value encoded in the primary QR code / barcode.

label_url_extra.description: Value encoded in the secondary code.

photo_ids.description: Ids of photos already in the account to attach.

measured_quantity.description: For items measured in something other than units.

type.description: Kind of measurement; set on create only.

name.description: The unit, e.g. kg, ft, l, units (see sortly_list_units).

tools.name: sortly_update_item
tools.title: Update an item or folder
tools.description: Change fields on an existing item or folder — e.g. set a new quantity after a stock count, rename it, or relocate a folder via parent_id. Only the fields you pass change; pass null to clear a nullable field. Sending tags or custom_attribute_values replaces them. WRITE. Sortly: PUT /api/v1/items/{item_id} (returns 204).

item_id.description: The item's or folder's numeric id.

parent_id.description: Move into this folder (null = root). To move PART of an item's stock use sortly_move_item.

min_quantity.description: Minimum level; a Quantity alert can fire when stock reaches it.

custom_attribute_values.description: Custom field values. Look up ids with sortly_list_custom_fields first.

value.description: Value to store; null clears it.

label_url.description: Value encoded in the primary QR code / barcode.

label_url_extra.description: Value encoded in the secondary code.

photo_ids.description: Ids of photos already in the account to attach.

measured_quantity.description: New measured amount for a measured item.

value.description: The measured amount (the unit is fixed at creation).

tools.name: sortly_move_item
tools.title: Move stock to another folder
tools.description: Move some or all of an item's quantity to another folder (items only — relocate a folder with sortly_update_item parent_id). A partial move splits off a new item with the same sid; a full move relocates the item; a matching item at the destination is merged, and the returned id is the destination's. Undo by moving it back. WRITE. Sortly: POST /api/v1/items/{item_id}/move.

folder_id.description: Destination folder. Omit to move to the root level.

leave_zero_quantity.description: Keep a zero-quantity record in the source folder. Default false.

tools.name: sortly_create_alert
tools.title: Create an alert
tools.description: Create a stock alert on an item (type Quantity, e.g. threshold_method quantity_less_than with threshold_value 5, or less_than_or_equal_to_min_quantity), or a DateReminder on a datetime custom field (custom_attribute_id + before/after/same_day + threshold_interval). WRITE. Sortly: POST /api/v1/alerts.

type.description: Quantity = stock threshold; DateReminder = date custom field.

threshold_method.description: What triggers it: a quantity_* method for Quantity, before/after/same_day for DateReminder.

threshold_value.description: The number compared against (or the interval count).

threshold_interval.description: Required for DateReminder; omit for Quantity.

custom_attribute_id.description: For DateReminder: the datetime custom field to watch.

recipient_groups.description: Who is notified: owners, admins, members, limited, or a custom role name. Default owners.

tools.name: sortly_create_job
tools.title: Create a job
tools.description: Create a job (and its job folder) in not_started status. Name must be unique in the company. Then use sortly_pull_items_into_job to record the stock it uses. WRITE. Sortly: POST /api/v1/jobs.

external_job_link.description: Link to the job in another system.

subfolders.description: Subfolder names to create, up to 25.

custom_field_values.description: Up to 2 job custom field values.

tools.name: sortly_pull_items_into_job
tools.title: Pull items into a job
tools.description: Move quantities of existing items (from any folders) into a job's folder — how usage on a job is recorded. Up to 100 items per call; items are processed independently, so ALWAYS check data.errors (a partial failure still returns 200). Undo with sortly_return_items_from_job. Returns 403 on a completed job. WRITE. Sortly: POST /api/v1/jobs/{job_id}/items.

item_id.description: Item to move onto the job.

item_version.description: Version from the last read of the item; stale is rejected.

leave_zero_quantity.description: Keep a zero-quantity copy in the original folder.

notes.description: Optional note kept in each item's history.

tools.name: sortly_return_items_from_job
tools.title: Return items from a job
tools.description: Move items off a job's folder back into inventory (destination_folder_id, or All Items if omitted). Up to 100 per call; check data.errors — items are processed one by one. WRITE. Sortly: POST /api/v1/jobs/{job_id}/items/return.

item_id.description: Item on the job to move off it.

item_version.description: Version from the last read of the item; stale is rejected.

destination_folder_id.description: Folder to return it to; omit for All Items.

leave_zero_quantity.description: Keep a zero-quantity copy in the job's folder.

notes.description: Optional note recorded in the item's history.

tools.name: sortly_create_purchase_order
tools.title: Draft a purchase order
tools.description: Create a purchase order in draft status (no stock or ordering happens until it is moved on in Sortly). Sortly computes amounts, sub_total and total from the lines; omit purchase_order_number to have one generated. Needs Purchase Orders on the plan (else 402). WRITE. Sortly: POST /api/v1/purchase_orders.

purchase_order_number.description: Unique PO number, max 20 chars. Omit to auto-generate.

vendor.description: The vendor, captured on the PO.

unit_of_measure.description: Unit abbreviation, e.g. units, ft, kg.

unit_rate.description: Price per unit. Omit for an unpriced line.
